source_sha256_binding.method: SHA-256 of the function's literal source text in the approved file (decorators included, LF-normalized, comments and whitespace included)
source_sha256_binding.reason: ast.unparse output depends on the CPython patch version (PEP 701 f-string quote reuse). The 2026-09-12 run_mass_roc_session pin was derived on CPython 3.12.13; the Pi candidate runs 3.12.3, where the same unmodified source serialises differently. Qualification qual-20260913 therefore failed TC_QUALIFIED_PATH_INVARIANT with pinned_mismatch ['run_mass_roc_session'] although ast.dump matched exactly and the function was never edited (the file is byte-identical across 90d9fe8, ee2c167 and f3d246e; its last change was 2026-09-12). Literal source text is interpreter-independent and strictly stricter than unparse.
